statement: You are given an integer array nums.
A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return the largest sum that any subarray of nums can have.
When every element is negative, the answer is the single largest element, because the subarray must contain at least one element.

examples.explanation: [4, -1, 2, 1] adds up to 6, and no other subarray does better.
[5, -1, 5] adds up to 9. Going past the -20 only lowers the sum.
Every element is negative, so the best subarray is the single element -1.
